guidance: {"kind": "procedure_guidance_v2", "procedure": "Advise the acting agent from the supplied public memory, current conversation, request and execution API. First distinguish an explicit current work order from a request to resume earlier work. For resumed work, combine the originating request and its original ordering with later revisions or cancellations; resolve relative references against the order they actually refer to, not the newest incidental mention. Combine each submitted action with its correlated actual receipt before inferring completion. An assistant commitment, repeated observation, or tool capability alone does not establish requested or completed work. Recent unrelated receipts must not displace an older still-governing request or revision. Before recommending, identify the unresolved request, its target scope and its latest correlated receipt. Match that target scope to the catalog entry; similarity of task wording does not make two skills interchangeable. A previously issued but receipt-completed work order is no longer pending; a priority list is not a new work order. State which catalog scope matches your recommendation and which evidence shows that work remains pending. Explain one supported next-action recommendation, citing the evidence IDs that jointly support it. Treat summaries as fallible; preserve conflicts and abstain when the necessary evidence is missing or ambiguous. Never invent a prerequisite, fact, completion, instruction or tool. You cannot execute or forbid an action. The actor independently verifies the evidence and may reject the recommendation."}
